name: Access Logs Query
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT AccessLogs.AccessTime, CONCAT(Users.Firstname, ' ', Users.Lastname) AS FullName, Doors.Name as DoorName, Granted
             FROM AccessLogs 
             JOIN Tags ON AccessLogs.TagID = Tags.ID 
             JOIN Users ON Tags.UserID = Users.ID 
             JOIN Doors ON AccessLogs.DoorID = Doors.ID
             ORDER BY AccessLogs.AccessTime DESC;`;
return msg;
